originality.rationale: The statement singled out for novelty is earliest-start positional rigidity of maximally one-rich factors at every 4-adic witness length, paired with a prefix-relative defect envelope. Literature already covers abelian max/min cardinalities: do NOT interpret the numerical envelope alone as independent of that work. The position of first maximizer does not follow from knowing only the extremal counts, and relevant inspected primary text and published-finding corpus searches supplied no dominating first-position theorem.
